tagShapeMismatches.english: {@i The Rise of Tiamat} begins immediately after the conclusion of {@i Hoard of the Dragon Queen}, and assumes that the characters have returned to Waterdeep in the aftermath of that adventure. While in the city, the adventurers are summoned to the first meeting of the Council of Waterdeep. While at that gathering, they hear the sounding of the ancient {@item Draakhorn|RoT} that heralds the next stage of the Cult of the Dragon's plots. (See {@adventure Chapter 17|RoT|8} for more information on the {@item Draakhorn|RoT}, but be sure to withhold that information until the characters have played through the "{@adventure Chapter 10: The Sea of Moving Ice|RoT|2}.")
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@i 提亞馬特的崛起}緊接在{@i 龍後的寶山}結局之後，並假設角色們在那次冒險後返回了深水城。在這座城市中，冒險者們被召喚參加深水城議會的第一次會議。在那次集會中，他們聽到了古老的{@item 龍吼號角|RoT}的聲響，這預示著龍巫教的陰謀進入了下一階段。（關於{@item 龍吼號角|RoT}的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 第十七章|RoT|8}，但務必在角色們完成"{@adventure 第10章：移動冰海|RoT|2}"之前保留這些資訊。）

tagShapeMismatches.english: Rian points out that the Zhentarim have a keen interest in Xonthal's Tower. Ownership of the tower is under discussion by the council, but the tiefling wants to deal directly with the adventurers, who have claim to the tower by right of conquest. The Zhentarim are willing to purchase the adventurers' interest in the tower for 50,000 gold pieces, and Rian can throw in a {@item Potion of Greater Healing|| greater healing potion}, a {@item potion of frost giant strength}, and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell earthquake} to sweeten the deal. This price could go up considerably if the party negotiates agreeable terms from the other factions for the Zhentarim's support—up to an additional 25,000 gp, at your discretion.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瑞安指出，散塔林會對贊薩爾之塔有著濃厚的興趣。塔的所有權正在由議會討論，但這個提夫林人想直接與冒險者們交易，他們透過征服權擁有對塔的主張。散塔林會願意以50,000金幣購買冒險者們對塔的利益，並且瑞安可以額外提供一瓶{@item 高等治療藥水||高效治療藥水}、一瓶{@item 霜巨人之力藥水}和一張{@spell 地震術}的{@item 法術卷軸}來增加交易的吸引力。如果黨派從其他派系那裡為散塔林會的支援談判出可接受的條件，這個價格可能會大幅提升——在你的判斷下，最多可增加25,000金幣。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Three of the five wyrmspeakers of the cult—{@creature Galvan|RoT} the Blue, Rezmir the Black, and {@creature Severin|RoT} himself, who wears the {@item Red Dragon Mask|RoTOS}—are already at the Well of Dragons and beyond the party's reach. However, the white wyrmspeaker {@creature Varram|RoT} is forced to leave the security of his stronghold after losing possession of the {@item White Dragon Mask|RoTOS}, while the green wyrmspeaker {@creature Neronvain|RoT} engages in raids against the elves of the Misty Forest with his draconic ally, Chuth. When word comes to the Council of Waterdeep that two of the five wyrmspeakers might be at large, the adventurers seize the opportunity to strike.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 邪教五位龍語者中的三位——藍龍{@creature 加爾文|RoT}、黑龍瑞茲米爾，以及佩戴著{@item 紅龍面具|RoTOS}的{@creature 賽維林|RoT}本人——已經抵達龍井並超出了冒險者的接觸範圍。然而，白龍語者{@creature 瓦拉姆|RoT}在失去了{@item 白龍面具|RoTOS}後被迫離開了他堡壘的安全區，而綠龍語者{@creature 內洛維|RoT}則和他的龍族盟友楚斯對迷霧森林的精靈發動了襲擊。當深水城議會得知五位龍語者中有兩位可能仍在活動時，冒險者們抓住了這次打擊他們的機會。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The chest also holds an amethyst-set {@item Ring of Poison Resistance||ring of resistance (poison)} and two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} of {@spell protection from energy}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 箱子裡還裝有一個鑲嵌紫水晶的{@item 毒素抗性戒指||抗毒戒指}和兩張{@spell 防護能量}的{@item 法術卷軸||法術卷軸}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As long as the characters wear these garlands, they are {@condition invisible} to Chuth's animal spies (part of the magic imbued into the area around the dragon's lair) as they approach {@creature Neronvain|RoT}'s stronghold. In addition, the first time a character wearing a garland is confronted by Chuth, he or she feels a stirring warmth from the garland and automatically succeeds on the saving throw against the dragon's Frightful Presence.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 只要角色們佩戴這些花環，他們在接近{@creature 內洛維|RoT}的要塞時，對楚斯的動物間諜（龍穴周圍注入的魔法的一部分）就是{@condition 隱形}的。此外，第一次佩戴花環的角色面對楚斯時，會從花環中感受到一股溫暖湧動，並且自動成功透過對抗龍的駭人威儀的豁免檢定。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The entrance tunnel to this chamber is protected by a {@spell glyph of warding} attuned to {@creature Neronvain|RoT}. A {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices the glyph. If anyone but {@creature Neronvain|RoT} steps within 5 feet of the glyph, it erupts.All creatures within 20 feet of the glyph must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 通往這個房間的入口隧道由一個與{@creature 內洛維|RoT}調諧的{@spell 守衛刻文}保護。一個{@dc 14}智力（{@skill 調查}）檢定可以發現這個刻文。如果除了{@creature 內洛維|RoT}之外的任何人踏入刻文5尺範圍內，它會爆發。所有在刻文20尺範圍內的生物必須進行一次{@dc 14}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到22點（{@dice 5d8}）酸傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: That night, each of the adventurers are targeted by a customized version of the {@spell dream} spell, cast and crafted by {@creature Red Wizard|RoT} illusionists. Each character is confronted in a vision by a pale {@creature Red Wizard|RoT} who says, "We have further questions for you." Elves and other creatures that do not sleep are not subject to this effect.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 那天晚上，每位冒險者都成為了由{@creature 紅袍巫師會|RoT}幻術師施放並精心製作的{@spell 託夢術}法術的定製版本的目標。每個角色在幻象中被一個蒼白的{@creature 紅袍巫師會|RoT}質問，他說："我們對你們有進一步的問題。"精靈和其他不睡覺的生物不受此效果影響。

tagShapeMismatches.english: See area 8 in "{@area The Well of Dragons|201|x}" for more information on the {@item Draakhorn|RoT}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 有關{@item 龍吼號角|RoT}的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 龍之井|201|x}"中的區域8。

tagShapeMismatches.english: For any character entering area 8, the sound fades to silence—because any creature that enters the chamber is temporarily {@condition deafened} and must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. Success indicates the deafness ends 2 minutes after the {@item Draakhorn|RoT} ceases to sound. Failure indicates the character remains {@condition deafened} for 1 hour after the {@item Draakhorn|RoT} ceases to sound.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 對於任何進入區域8的角色，聲音都會逐漸消失，因為任何進入該區域的生物都會暫時處於{@condition 耳聾}狀態，並且必須進行一次{@dc 12}的體質豁免檢定。成功表示在{@item 龍吼號角|RoT}停止發聲後的2分鐘後，耳聾狀態結束。失敗則表示角色在{@item 龍吼號角|RoT}停止發聲後的1小時內保持{@condition 耳聾}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: After the din of the tunnel, this chamber seems preternaturally silent—until you realize you are completely {@condition deafened} in the presence of the fearsome {@item Draakhorn|RoT}. Carved from the massive horn of an ancient red dragon, it hangs suspended by chains from the ceiling of this chamber, blasted with fire to a dark ebony hue and bound by thick bands of bronze. Draconic runes etched into its surface glow with a purple eldritch fire.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在隧道的喧囂之後，這個房間顯得異常安靜——直到你意識到在令人畏懼的{@item 龍吼號角|RoT}面前你完全{@condition 耳聾}。它由一隻古老紅龍的巨大龍角雕刻而成，懸掛在房間的天花板上，被火焰燻黑至深褐色，並由厚厚的青銅帶固定。刻在其表面的龍語符文閃爍著紫色的神秘火焰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The main lava tunnel of the southern warrens exits inside the black chapel ({@area area 5|1fc|x}) of {@creature Tiamat|RoT}'s temple. Prisoners intended for sacrifice are brought up to the black chapel and marched to the temple entrance, and forced out into the plaza for the waiting dragons to feast on. This exit is unguarded.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 南部巢穴的主要熔岩隧道出口位於{@creature 提亞馬特|RoT}神廟的黑色小教堂（{@area 區域5|1fc|x}）。註定要被獻祭的囚犯被帶到黑色小教堂，然後被帶到神廟入口，並被趕出到廣場上，供等待的龍群享用。這個出口無人守衛。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The head of the cult remains in the temple sanctuary (area 13), wearing the {@item Mask of the Dragon Queen|RoT} while the Red Wizards weave their magic. He can fight defensively or offensively as needed, and rank-and-file cultists fight to the death as long as they know {@creature Severin|RoT} is alive. See {@adventure appendix D|RoT|12} for {@creature Severin|RoT}'s statistics.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 邪教的首領仍然在神廟的聖所（區域13）中，紅袍法師編織他們的魔法時，他戴著{@item 龍後面具|RoT}。他可以根據需要進行防守或進攻戰鬥，而且普通訊徒只要知道{@creature 賽維林|RoT}還活著就會戰鬥到死。有關{@creature 賽維林|RoT}的具體數值，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|RoT|12}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Rath Modar leads the ritual of guidance, but any {@creature Red Wizard|RoT} can take on that role. When the temple is attacked, he hands over his part in the ritual and leads the attack against the adventurers. See {@adventure appendix D|RoT|12} for {@creature Rath Modar|HotDQ|Rath Modar's} statistics.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 拉斯·莫達主持引導儀式，但任何{@creature 紅袍巫師會|RoT}都可以承擔這個角色。當神廟遭到攻擊時，他交出儀式中的部分並領導對冒險者的攻擊。有關{@creature 拉斯·莫達|HotDQ|拉思·摩達爾的}具體數值，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|RoT|12}。

numericDifferences.english: The Cult Strikes Back (Part 1)
numericDifferences.localized: 邪教反擊（第一部分）

numericDifferences.english: The Cult Strikes Back (Part 2)
numericDifferences.localized: 邪教反擊（第二部分）

numericDifferences.english: The Cult Strikes Back (Part 3)
numericDifferences.localized: 邪教反擊（第三部分）

numericDifferences.english: Stage 4
numericDifferences.localized: 第四階段

numericDifferences.english: The ice caves are open to the sea, creating banks of vapor that roll constantly through Oyaviggaton's corridors and chambers. This fog is more common in the low points of the caverns. In areas noted as +10 feet on the map, visibility is unrestricted unless a patch of random fog is encountered. In areas noted as 0 feet, visibility is limited to 75 feet. In areas noted as–10 feet or–20 feet, visibility is limited to 45 feet.
numericDifferences.localized: 冰洞向海洋開放，形成蒸汽團，在奧亞維加頓的走廊和房間中不斷翻滾。這種霧在洞穴的低點更為常見。在地圖上標記為+10尺的區域，除非遇到隨機霧團，否則能見度不受限制。在標記為0尺的區域，能見度限制在75尺內。在標記為-10尺或-20尺的區域，能見度限制在45尺內。

numericDifferences.english: Arauthator brought a pack of unwitting kobolds to Oyaviggaton generations ago, and the creatures have been serving him in the frigid cold ever since. In the event of an encounter, a squad of {@dice 3d6} {@creature Kobold||kobolds} is working in or passing through the area. If the characters are dressed as Ice Hunter villagers or are wearing some other appropriate disguise, the kobolds eye them warily but don't immediately sound an alarm. Make a single Wisdom check for the kobolds with a DC equal to the lowest of the characters' checks to disguise themselves. The kobolds' Wisdom modifier is–2, but they have advantage on this check because of their numbers. If the check is successful (or if the characters aren't disguised), the kobolds launch a single volley of sling stones at the intruders, then flee in as many directions as possible to report the intrusion to the ice toads or ice trolls.
numericDifferences.localized: 阿勞索多爾多年前帶來了一群無知的狗頭人，這些生物自此一直在嚴寒中為他服務。如果遇到，一隊{@dice 3d6} {@creature Kobold||狗頭人}正在該區域工作或經過。如果角色們裝扮成冰獵者村民或穿著其他合適的偽裝，狗頭人會警惕地看著他們，但不會立即發出警報。為狗頭人進行一次單獨的感知檢定，難度等級等於角色們偽裝自己的最低檢定結果。狗頭人的感知調整值是-2，但由於他們的數量，他們在這次檢定上有優勢。如果檢定成功（或者如果角色們沒有偽裝），狗頭人會向入侵者發射一輪彈弓石子，然後儘可能多地向不同方向逃跑，向冰蟾或冰巨魔報告入侵。

numericDifferences.english: If the characters announced their presence by fighting the {@creature ice troll|RoT}, the 2 {@creature Kobold||kobolds} will be visibly agitated, even though Maccath shows little concern. The kobolds have been directed to stay with the tiefling and follow her orders, which mostly means undertaking errands to the scriptorium (area 11). She also relies on them for cooking, housekeeping, and other mundane chores. The moment the characters make it clear that they are here to rescue Maccath, the kobolds make a dash for {@area area 12|0c1|x}. They alert the ice trolls unless they are stopped.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色們透過與{@creature ice troll|RoT|冰巨魔}戰鬥來宣佈他們的到來，那兩個{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}會顯得非常不安，儘管麥卡絲表現得不太關心。狗頭人被指示留在提夫林身邊並聽從她的命令，這主要意味著去抄寫室（區域11）跑腿。她還依賴他們來做飯、打掃衛生以及其他日常雜務。一旦角色們明確表示他們是來營救麥卡絲的，狗頭人就會衝向{@area 區域12|0c1|x}。除非被阻止，否則他們會警告冰巨魔。

numericDifferences.english: Those who didn't speak well in area 1 must ask {@creature Diderius|RoT} about {@creature Varram|RoT} to gain information about his whereabouts. Failure to do so respectfully causes {@creature Diderius|RoT} to say, "Leave me to my rest or face your doom." {@creature Diderius|RoT} opens the way only for those who are particularly decorous in this exchange.
numericDifferences.localized: 那些在第一區域未能妥善發言的人必須向{@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯}詢問關於{@creature Varram|RoT|瓦拉姆}的資訊以獲取其行蹤。若不夠恭敬，{@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯}會說"要麼讓我安息，要麼面對你的末日"。只有在這次對話中格外莊重的訪客，{@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯}才會為其開啟通路。

numericDifferences.english: The {@b fourth sundial} casts four shadows in an "X" shape. As the characters examine them, the shadows start slowly rotating around the face of the sundial, spinning faster and becoming shorter until they shrink into the gnomon and the sundial shows no shadow at all. The correct path in this case is the sundial itself. A character who jumps or climbs onto the sundial is drawn into its stone surface, then is suddenly dropped out of the sky to land harmlessly around sundial 5.
numericDifferences.localized: {@b 第四個日晷} 投射出四個影子，形成一個"X"形狀。當角色們檢查這些影子時，它們開始緩慢地圍繞日晷的表面旋轉，旋轉速度越來越快，影子變得越來越短，直到它們縮排日晷的指標中，日晷上完全沒有影子。在這種情況下，正確的路徑就是日晷本身。如果一個角色跳上或爬上日晷，他會被吸入其石質表面，然後突然從天而降，安全地落在第五個日晷周圍。

numericDifferences.english: You emerge from the path into an area far larger than any open area you expected to encounter in the maze garden. This rectangular space must be ninety feet across, with its far side almost 150 feet away. It looks like a boulder-strewn pasture, with a large pond to one side and a fenced vegetable garden and oversized cottage on the other. Sheep graze in the pasture, tended by a pair of cyclopes, but none of them are moving. They all appear frozen in time.
numericDifferences.localized: 你從小徑走出，進入一個比你預期在迷宮花園中遇到的任何開放區域都要大得多的地方。這個長方形的空間大約有90尺寬，遠端幾乎有150尺遠。它看起來像是一個散佈著巨石的牧場，一邊是一個大型池塘，另一邊是一個圍起來的菜園和一間超大的小屋。綿羊在牧場上吃草，由一對獨眼巨人看管，但它們都不動。它們看起來都像是被時間凍結了。

numericDifferences.english: The chest contains three scrolls: two {@item Scroll of Protection||scroll of protection against fire elementals} and one {@item Scroll of Protection||scroll of protection against earth elementals}. Characters who claim these scrolls can use them to move safely past the elementals, if they bunch tightly together to keep everyone inside the effect's five-foot radius from the caster. With only one {@item Scroll of Protection||scroll of protection against earth elementals}, characters will probably be forced to deal with the earth elementals at least once.
numericDifferences.localized: 箱子裡有三個卷軸：兩個{@item Scroll of Protection||防護火元素生物的卷軸}和一個{@item Scroll of Protection||防護土元素的卷軸}。角色們如果拿到這些卷軸，可以安全地透過元素生物，只要他們緊密地聚集在一起，讓每個人都在施法者5尺半徑效果範圍內。由於只有一個{@item Scroll of Protection||防護土元素的卷軸}，角色們可能至少需要面對一次土元素生物。

numericDifferences.english: A character trained in one of the following skills can make a check to search the library for a work on that subject: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Performance}, {@skill Persuasion}, {@skill Religion}, or {@skill Sleight of Hand}. Multiply the total of the check by 10 to get the gp value of the single most valuable book a character can find on that subject. Each skill check takes 10 minutes, but many characters can be searching at the same time. Characters who search for more books take a cumulative–10 penalty to subsequent checks.
numericDifferences.localized: 接受過以下技能之一訓練的角色可以進行檢定，在圖書館中搜尋有關該主題的著作：{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}、{@skill Athletics||運動}、{@skill Arcana||奧秘}、{@skill History||歷史}、{@skill Medicine||醫療}、{@skill Nature||自然}、{@skill Performance||表演}、{@skill Persuasion||說服}、{@skill Religion||宗教}或{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}。將檢定的總分乘以10，即可得到角色在該主題上能找到的單本最有價值的書籍的金幣價值。每次技能檢定需要10分鐘，但許多角色可以同時進行搜尋。尋找更多書籍的角色對後續檢定會有累積的-10懲罰。

numericDifferences.english: Two massive hourglasses occupy this irregularly shaped chamber. Their glass globes are nearly fifteen feet across, with each hourglass rising almost to the ceiling thirty feet overhead. Each is suspended by chains, pulleys, and gears in such a way that it can be turned over to set its sand running.
numericDifferences.localized: 兩個巨大的沙漏佔據了這個形狀不規則的房間。它們的玻璃球體直徑近15尺，每個沙漏高達30尺，幾乎觸及天花板。每個沙漏都透過鏈條、滑輪和齒輪懸掛，可以翻轉以啟動沙子流動。

numericDifferences.english: Clerics and paladins of good-aligned deities take a–6 penalty.
numericDifferences.localized: 善良陣營神祇的牧師和聖武士受到-6的懲罰。

numericDifferences.english: Other characters wearing visible signs of worshiping any good-aligned deity take a–4 penalty.
numericDifferences.localized: 其他佩戴明顯崇拜任何善良陣營神祇標誌的角色會受到-4的懲罰。

numericDifferences.english: A character takes a–4 penalty each time he or she addresses Eseldra Yeth without using her title of tharchion.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色在稱呼艾瑟德拉·伊斯時沒有使用她的頭銜'總督'，每次都會遭受-4的懲罰。

numericDifferences.english: A character who struggles against the bonds or who tries to cast a spell or use some other ability not hindered by physical restraint is struck by pain so severe that he or she is briefly {@condition incapacitated}. That character's next Charisma check made within the dream takes a–2 penalty.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個角色如果掙扎反抗束縛，或者嘗試施放法術或使用其他不受身體限制影響的能力，將會遭受極度的痛苦，以至於他或她暫時處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態。該角色在夢中進行的下一次魅力檢定會受到-2的懲罰。

numericDifferences.english: The first three stages of {@creature Severin|RoT}'s plan are complete. Stage 4 will be completed by the time the characters arrive at the Well of Dragons. Stage 5 begins soon after the heroes and their factional allies arrive, and becomes the focal point of this final battle against the cult.
numericDifferences.localized: {@creature Severin|RoT|賽維林}計劃的前三個階段已經完成。第四階段將在角色們到達龍井時完成。第五階段將在英雄們及其派系盟友到達後不久開始，併成為這場對抗邪教的最終戰鬥的焦點。

numericDifferences.english: With area 16 empty, a prisoner escort consisting of 5 {@creature Dragonclaw|HotDQ|dragonclaws} has begun to move prisoners from area 17 up to the temple. Additionally, a {@creature dragonfang|RoT}, 5 {@creature Dragonclaw|HotDQ|dragonclaws}, and 2 {@creature Guard Drake|HotDQ|guard drakes} working nearby arrive within 2 rounds if a disturbance breaks out. (See {@adventure appendix D|RoT|12} for these creatures' statistics) The prisoners aren't shackled together, but most of them are weak from starvation. Ten human {@creature Commoner||commoners} can fight alongside the characters if they acquire weapons. The characters are free to make use of these allies any way they see fit. If sent into combat, they quickly perish.
numericDifferences.localized: 隨著區域16空置，由5個{@creature Dragonclaw|HotDQ|龍爪}組成的囚犯護送隊已開始將區域17的囚犯轉移到神廟。此外，如果發生騷亂，附近工作的1個{@creature dragonfang|RoT|龍牙}、5個{@creature Dragonclaw|HotDQ|龍爪}和2個{@creature Guard Drake|HotDQ|守衛龍獸}將在2輪內到達。（見{@adventure 附錄D|RoT|12}瞭解這些生物的具體數值）囚犯們沒有被銬在一起，但大多數人因飢餓而虛弱。如果有武器，10個人類{@creature Commoner||平民}可以與角色們並肩作戰。角色們可以自由地以他們認為合適的方式利用這些盟友。如果被派去戰鬥，他們會很快死去。

numericDifferences.english: At the end of the Red Wizards' turn, if fewer than five Red Wizards used an action to perform the ritual, the portal floating in the great apse (area 7) wavers and no progress in the ritual is made. If fewer than five Red Wizards perform the ritual for 2 rounds in succession, the portal collapses and the count of successfully focused rounds is reset to 0.
numericDifferences.localized: 在紅袍法師的回合結束時，如果少於五位紅袍法師使用行動來執行儀式，那麼漂浮在宏偉後殿（區域7）的傳送門會波動，儀式沒有進展。如果連續兩輪少於五位紅袍法師執行儀式，傳送門會崩潰，成功集中的輪數計數將重置為0。

numericDifferences.english: {@creature Tiamat|RoT} takes a–5 penalty to attack rolls, saving throw DCs, and to her AC, and her hit point maximum is reduced by 75.
numericDifferences.localized: {@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}的攻擊擲骰、豁免檢定DC和AC受到-5的懲罰，她的生命值上限減少了75。
